ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35% high-intensity (white/cream) to 65% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) blobs located on the outer distal regions of both lobes. The right lobe contains three distinct, low-intensity (dark) circular focal spots embedded within the white field. The left lobe displays a more diffuse, speckled transition from dark to light intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/6th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations throughout the boundary. Pixel-amplitude is highest at the distal tips, showing jagged peaks, and moderate along the trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the posterior boundary of both lobes, transitioning to a slight concavity approaching the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast irregular clusters on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, suggesting rough-textured colonization or scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular protrusions and textural thickening on the distal lobe tips (possible barnacle colonization or trauma-induced calcification).
other_distinctive_markers: Unique three-dot triangular pigmentation pattern on the high-intensity field of the right lobe.
